CICC has consistently maintained a leading position in both fundraising volume and the number of completed Hong Kong IPO transactions. Colleagues are empowered to take on core project roles while building critical skills in problem-solving, project management, and client communication. Through active deal execution, the Investment Banking Division is committed to nurturing a new generation of high-caliber investment banking professionals.
